notes.title: Removed IAP in favor of user marketplace
notes.notes: Removed the IAP in favor of users selling / trading with each other.  Everything is now even more accessible via play only!

notes.title: Three new levels to battle on!
notes.notes: Today we add three new levels and loads of bug fixes!

notes.title: Updates for 5/28
notes.notes: Grenades    That is right!  Blow your enemies or yourself to bits in this latest addition!

notes.title: Calling Air Support!
notes.notes:
Massive changes have been made to the Battle Match system.   Wait times have been cut to next to nothing!     Guns have been made more accurate and the big one Air Support will drop in additional firepower during the battle!   Be sure to get to it before the other team!

While we still lack a highly active user base we continue to group up every night at 9 pm eastern time for the best chance to get into a larger and more exciting match. Come join us!

notes.title: Bigger battles, New levels, Shields, and Guns!
notes.notes:
Command wishes to announce the scheduled BIG BATTLES everyday to try and coordinate our small player base who are sick of fighting the AI's. See count down timer in game for each days battle.

Additionally this update adds massive firepower. New shotguns and now energy weapons are part of the arsenal.

One new map has been added and work continues on the "big city" map as we continue to add art to the blocked out world.  

Shields can now regenerate   If you hide for a moment your shield can recharge upto 50 percent!
